area: Westside Canal area off Highway 58, Kern County
disposition: forward progress stopped; dozers canceled; extensive mop-up
summary: Crews were sent a little before 9:30 p.m. to a brush fire burning in heavy river-bottom vegetation between the Westside Canal and the Kern River flood canal, reached by dirt roads off Highway 58. Fire command reported roughly an acre at first look, then about a half acre burning in thick grass and brush. Access was the problem of the night: engines staged off the highway, crews flagged in a dirt road for the units behind them, and incoming resources were held on the assignment. Forward progress was stopped shortly after 10 p.m. and dozers were canceled, leaving ground crews to work extensive mop-up in the river bottom.

area: Baker Street at Dolores Street, Bakersfield
summary: A caller reported that a person on an e-bike struck a pedestrian at Baker and Dolores.

disposition: officers assigned to check on the person
summary: A caller asked officers to check on an autistic adult family member who was not where he was expected. Units were assigned to the address.

disposition: deputies sent; caller had no description of either person
summary: A caller reported a loud argument between a man and a woman with what sounded like a battery, and said the woman was telling the man to stop choking her. Deputies were sent to the rural address, and the caller could not describe either person.

type: search after possible collision into a building
disposition: area searched; no one found; residence with open side gate cleared
summary: Officers searched a south Bakersfield neighborhood after a report of a possible vehicle into a building, with subjects running from the scene. Residents along the street reported nothing, and a residence with an open side gate was cleared.
A young caller reported a family disturbance in an apartment, saying a woman was pushing him around the residence.
Crews were sent to an apartment for a patient with a hemorrhage.
Units were advised of a semi with a white box trailer swerving and unable to maintain its lane, with a possible tire problem.
A caller reported a baby who was conscious and breathing but possibly having a seizure.
An engine was sent to a commercial fire alarm at a Key West Drive business.

disposition: caller uncooperative and disconnected; officers sent
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment for a fight in progress in which the caller said one person was armed with an axe and a second person with a knife. The caller refused to give any further information and hung up.
A tenth of an acre was reported burning at a slow rate of spread between a road and a field break, and county equipment handled it without additional resources.

area: northbound Interstate 5 near Weiser Road, Kern County
summary: A semi with a white box trailer was reported cutting off vehicles at high speed on northbound Interstate 5 near Weiser Road.

disposition: call re-queued for a later hour
summary: A caller asked that a welfare check be re-queued for later and mentioned that it could involve a suicide risk.
A caller reported some type of fire on top of a roof, possibly a wreath, and crews were sent to get more information.
An ambulance was sent for an unconscious patient.
A caller said her boyfriend battered her and then the line went dead.

disposition: officers sent to check on the person
summary: A caller asked officers to check on someone at the Bakersfield College campus.

area: Baker Street at Truxtun Avenue, Bakersfield
summary: A pickup was reported stuck on the railroad tracks at Baker and Truxtun. The caller was a railroad employee who said his company was being notified.
